component.name: NectarLink
component.summary: Your Android phone and your PC, working as one
让你的 Android 手机和电脑协同工作

description.p: NectarLink links your Android phone and your PC over the local network, end-to-end encrypted, with no account and no cloud. It needs the NectarLink app on the phone; pair them by scanning a QR code, by comparing a 6-digit code, or over USB.

ul.li: Phone notifications on the PC, with replies, actions and a copy button for one-time codes
SMS, MMS and chat-app messages in one inbox; see, answer and place calls through the phone
Clipboard sync both ways, with optional encrypted history
Files and folders both ways at Wi-Fi speed, synced folders, and compatibility with LocalSend devices
The phone's photos on the PC, and Photo backup into ~/Pictures/NectarLink
Screen mirroring with the phone's sound, phone apps in their own windows, and typing on the phone with the PC keyboard
Use the phone as a touchpad, keyboard, presentation remote or button deck for the PC

description.p: This is a community package: it installs upstream's official portable Linux build, unmodified, and follows upstream's stable releases.

ul.li: Received files go to ~/Downloads/Nectarlink, Photo backup and screenshots to ~/Pictures, voice recordings to ~/Documents. Other folders can be picked in the file dialog.

The PC and the phone have to reach each other on the local network: mDNS on UDP 5353, NectarLink's own UDP port and, for LocalSend, 53317. Upstream's installer adds firewall rules for these; a Flatpak can't, so if your firewall blocks local traffic, allow it yourself.
Updates come through Flatpak; the app's own updater stays off.
Not available in the sandbox: launch at login, the file manager's "Send to" entry, and browsing the phone's storage in the file manager (it needs FUSE on the host).

description.p: A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Phone as a webcam (needs the v4l2loopback driver loaded on the host) and phone as keyboard and mouse through /dev/uinput: flatpak override --user --device=all org.nectarlink.desktop
Bluetooth features (calls audio, waking the PC): flatpak override --user --allow=bluetooth --system-talk-name=org.bluez org.nectarlink.desktop
Lock and sleep the PC from the phone: flatpak override --user --system-talk-name=org.freedesktop.login1 org.nectarlink.desktop
Let the phone browse your whole home folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home org.nectarlink.desktop
Undo all of these: flatpak override --user --reset org.nectarlink.desktop
